citation.authors: Bhakta NR, Bime C, Kaminsky DA, McCormack MC et al
citation.journal: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine

cited_by.title: Lung function tests and race correction in spirometry

record.population: Official American Thoracic Society workshop (2021) and review of newer evidence
record.finding: Current ATS standards promoted race- and ethnicity-specific reference equations; concern grew that this gives a false view of fixed differences and may mask differential exposures and norm health disparities. The statement recommends replacing them with race-neutral average reference equations, alongside a broader re-evaluation of how lung function tests are used for clinical, employment and insurance decisions, a call to include missing stakeholders, and a caution about uncertain effects and potential harms.
record.note: US society statement; abstract read in full. It is a recommendation, not a trial of outcomes.
